name: planetar
lore:
Planetars are celestial beings of immense power and unwavering dedication to good. They are the messengers of deities and the generals of celestial armies, often intervening in mortal affairs to aid the righteous and combat the forces of evil. Their presence radiates strength and inspires hope, a beacon against the encroaching darkness.

Imagine encountering a Planetar: a towering humanoid figure, skin shimmering with opalescent emerald light, vast wings of white feathers spread wide. Their eyes glow with celestial fire, and their very presence seems to hum with divine energy. They carry themselves with an air of confidence, their actions speaking louder than any words, embodying the virtues they champion.

These celestial warriors are most often found on the upper planes, but are occasionally sent to other planes to help those in need. Wielding celestial blades and wielding divine magic, a Planetar strides forth, bringing light and justice to the darkest corners of the multiverse, a true embodiment of divine might and unwavering righteousness.
